d: P. Rajagopal’s story sounds like a perfect rags-to-riches tale — a small-town vendor who built Saravana Bhavan into a global restaurant empire. But that’s not the whole story. Behind the success and fame was a darker side: a story of obsession, power, and a shocking crime that destroyed the reputation that he had built. In this video, I dig into the life of the "Dosa King" and how his relentless desires led to a murder that shook the entire country.
